newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AKZO NOBEL DIVESTS BRAZILIAN NYLON UNIT.
newsitem.headline: AKZO NOBEL DIVESTS BRAZILIAN NYLON UNIT.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Monday it had agreed to transfer the nylon business of Brazilian unit Cobafi to DuPont from April 22.

"DuPont and Akzo Nobel have signed an agreement effectuating the transfer of the nylon 6 industrial fibres business and operations of Cobafi, an Akzo Nobel subsidiary in Brazil, to DuPont as per April 22, 1997," Akzo Nobel said in a statement.
"The Brazilian nylon 6 operation is a relatively small activity of our industrial fibres business and no core activity. It will have a better future with DuPont," it said.
No financial details were given on the deal.
In february of this year, the two companies signed a letter of intent.
